name: Transmission
compose:
services:
  transmission:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/transmission:latest
    container_name: transmission
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:9091"
      - "51413:51413"
      - "51413:51413/udp"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "{TZ}"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/config:/config
      - /srv/downloads:/downloads
